# Organization Model

## Purpose
The Organization Model defines entities for representing business structures, customers, suppliers, and employees.

## Key Entities
- **Organization**: A business entity.
- **Branch**: A specific branch of an organization.
- **Site**: A physical location of an organization.
- **Customer**: Base entity for customers.
- **Supplier**: A business that provides goods or services.
- **Employee**: A person working for an organization.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Organization
    Baseclass <|-- Branch
    Baseclass <|-- Site
    Baseclass <|-- Customer
    Baseclass <|-- Supplier
    Baseclass <|-- Employee
    Baseclass <|-- Industry
    Baseclass <|-- SalesRegion
    Baseclass <|-- SalesPerson

    Organization "1" *-- "many" Branch
    Organization "1" *-- "many" Site
    Branch "many" -- "1" Organization
    Employee "many" -- "1" Organization
    
    Customer <|-- IndividualCustomer
    Customer <|-- OrganizationalCustomer
    OrganizationalCustomer "many" -- "1" Organization
    
    Customer "many" -- "1" Industry : industry
    SalesPerson "many" -- "1" Employee
    SalesPerson "many" -- "1" SalesRegion

    class Organization {
        +String name
        +String description
    }
    class Branch {
        +String name
        +Organization organization
    }
    class Site {
        +String name
        +Organization organization
    }
    class Employee {
        +Organization organization
        +String jobTitle
    }
```
